address: No.1 Neusoft Avenue, Qingchengshan Town, Dujiangyan City, Chengdu, Sichuan 611844, China
description: Chengdu Neusoft University is a private undergraduate university founded by Neusoft Holdings in 2003, located at the foot of Mount Qingcheng in Dujiangyan, Chengdu. Specializing in IT, software engineering, digital media, business management and health technology, it enrolls over 20,000 students across 30 undergraduate programs using the industry-integrated TOPCARES talent model. As Sichuan's first independent private本科 university to host full-time international students, it blends enterprise-partnered applied education with a scenic UNESCO-heritage campus.
motto: To Learn and to Apply (精勤博学，学以致用)
name: Chengdu Neusoft University
